LanguageData.TM_GuideReadDesc: Read how to use this device. Available even before its construction research.
LanguageData.TM_GuideStart: Your magical ship has reached the planet surface. Its core, two thrusters and beacons support local travel; the scenario supplies a limited fuel reserve. Use the pilot console when ready. Research and build your own workshops, life support and improvements.
LanguageData.TM_GuideResearch: New magical possibilities are ready. The notes below explain the relevant research and equipment.
LanguageData.TM_GuideNetwork: Magofuel and mana are separate resources. Thrusters spend magofuel; mana cannot replace it. Beacons connect nearby equipment. Configure sending and receiving separately for each resource. Crafting beacons requires both magofuel refining and electricity.
LanguageData.TM_GuideOwnership: Research unlocks production and progression. Already obtained equipment and already learned spells remain usable.
LanguageData.TM_GuideReread: Select a relevant magical device and choose Read guide to revisit its instructions.
